name: Hag’s Touch
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 3, spiritualist 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The touched creature visibly ages, appearing to all purposes as a venerable member of its race. It receives a –4 penalty to Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength that does not stack with age penalties.

Creatures immune to aging or immune to critical hits are immune to this spell’s effects. Children who are aged by this spell receive the penalties, but are not considered adults for any other purpose.
